limits: Independent standard-library audit of preserved metadata, raw trace events, fixture payloads and cache/native bytes. GPU output arrays are not retained, so general error metrics are not rederived from output tensors.
F0 has metadata and generator-state consistency, not direct synthetic operand-byte attestation.
Trace durations do not enter latency ratios; same/different valid kernel signatures are outcomes, not integrity gates.
Incidental v1 save is checked, but no fresh-process persistence behavior is claimed.
